subject: Discrepancy on April invoice — duplicated ingestion lines / proposed remediation
messages:
From: Maeve O'Connell <maeve.oconnell@ecuhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Discrepancy on April invoice — duplicated ingestion lines

Hi Jordan / Laura,

We reviewed our April statement and noticed a ~2x spike in ingestion volume that doesn't match our own logs. Attached is the export from our billing system (ecu_billing_export_Apr2027.csv) showing duplicate line items for connector IDs 72, 73. This caused an unexpected charge of €12,000 on invoice #RWD-0427.

Can Redwood confirm whether there was a server-side duplication or re-ingest? We need a goodwill remediation (credit or refund) and clear VAT handling because our AP team needs the VAT-corrected paperwork to reconcile.

For speed, please tell us: 1) provisional credit amount you intend to issue, 2) whether you'll issue a credit memo or refund to the card on file, and 3) timeline for corrected invoice/credit note with VAT lines.

Thanks — this is blocking our monthly close.

Maeve O'Connell
Head of Procurement, EcuHealth
accounts@ecuhealth.com

Maeve — thanks for flagging this and for the export. I'm escalating to finance and accounts receivable (cc'd) to get a remediation path lined up.

Initial ask answers:
- We will propose a provisional courtesy credit while we complete the root-cause review.
- We can either issue a credit memo (applied to the next invoice) or a payment refund; please confirm your preference.
- We will provide a VAT-aware credit note / corrected invoice once the credit approach is confirmed.

Laura / Markus: please see Maeve's CSV — looks like duplicated ingestion rows. Can you confirm whether this is a platform-side double-ingest or an upstream re-send? If it's our connector behavior, I'd like to route a one-time goodwill credit and a formal credit note for VAT purposes.

I'll keep the timeline tight — Jordan

Jordan Blake

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on April invoice — duplicated ingestion lines

Hi Maeve — thanks, we pulled the export and have run a quick reconciliation against our ingest logs. You're right: connector IDs 72 and 73 show duplicated ingest events between 2027-04-02 02:03 UTC and 2027-04-02 02:05 UTC. Preliminary notes:

- Cause (initial): a transient worker restart triggered a double-ack processing loop for ~3 minutes. We're working with infra to harden this path.
- Impact: duplicate token billing lines, net overcharge of €10,000 before VAT.

Remediation proposal (two-part):
1) Immediate courtesy/service credit: issue a goodwill credit equal to the net overcharge (we propose €9,840 net, VAT to be handled per your preference). This will be issued as a credit note we can apply to the next invoice.
2) Corrected invoice / credit note for tax: we'll generate a formal credit note that includes VAT adjustment lines (reverse charge if that's the right mechanism). Draft attached: redwood-draft-credit-memo-EcuHealth-0427.pdf.

Questions for EcuHealth (quick):
- Preference: credit memo applied to next invoice OR refund to the payment method? (Maeve indicated they prefer credit memo in her follow-up).
- VAT mechanism: do you require a reverse-charge credit note or a VAT-inclusive credit? Please confirm your VAT registration number so we can format the document correctly.

If you confirm the credit-memo route and provide your VAT number, we can issue the credit note within 3 business days and apply it immediately to your May statement.

Laura Bennett
AR Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-draft-credit-memo-EcuHealth-0427.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
